title: Should you detox heavy metals before/with a parasite cleanse?

grade.title: No qualifying human study in this corpus
grade.outcome: Combining a parasite cleanse with metal binding
grade.basis: No qualifying human study was located.

answerHtml: No human trial in this corpus tested a parasite cleanse together with a metal-binding protocol, or tested the order of the two. The question is not graded. Activated charcoal, which is sometimes named beside that claim, also has no located human metal trial.

sections.heading: What not to infer
sections.html: Public posts named commercial products next to this question. Those products are not evaluated here, and none is listed as a licensee on the certification register checked for this site.

sources.text: PubMed, the database used for the charcoal and chelator searches recorded in the corpus

buyHtml:
The Heavy Metal Tested and Certified public register listed no licensees on 15 October 2026. That page reported 0 certified brands and 0 certified products, and it stated that no brand has completed the three-lot baseline. A specimen layout on the register is an illustration, not a licensee. This page does not name or rank any brand.

The program states that certification is a measurement of a product against a published limit, not a statement that the product is safe. If a licensee is later listed for this category, it will be on the register.
